BiblicalUsage: God says, behold, the Lord will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee, and will toss thee like a ball into a large country. The word is overthrow, rejection: a man tossed like a ball, and covered. It appears once, in the judgment on Shebna, the steward who carved himself a tomb in the rock.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tossing is the end of self-promotion: Shebna carved his name in stone, and God tosses him like a ball into a far country.
